info.title: bmail HTTP API
info.description: End-to-end encrypted email backed by Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects. All `/api/*` routes are served by the Rust worker in `worker/src/router.rs`.

post.description: One-shot tenant bootstrap. Refuses if any users already exist.
Start a WebAuthn registration ceremony against an invite token.
Verify the attestation, create the user, and issue a session cookie.
Allocate a server-side WebAuthn challenge for sign-in.
Verify the assertion, update sign count, and issue a session cookie.
Step 1 of passphrase recovery: returns the recovery wrap and a sealed proof token.
Step 2: client returns the decrypted proof token, server issues a session.
Invalidate the current session cookie.

patch.description: Update mutable profile fields (currently just display_name).

get.description: List all email addresses owned by the authenticated user.
Derived contact list — every person the user has emailed or received from, deduped by canonical address, sorted by most recent interaction. Backs the to/cc/bcc autocomplete in Compose.
Read the user's remote-image settings: the global load-by-default flag and the allowlist of sender domains whose images load automatically.

put.description: Set whether remote images load by default for every sender (always via the /api/img proxy). Returns the updated settings.

post.description: Allowlist a sender domain so its remote images load automatically. Returns the updated settings.

delete.description: Remove a sender domain from the remote-image allowlist. Returns the updated settings.

get.description: List passkey credentials registered to the current user.

post.description: Start an add-passkey ceremony. Returns PRF-extension options and excludes existing creds.
Verify the new attestation and store the wrap of the user's existing X25519 priv.

delete.description: Remove a passkey credential + its wrap. Last passkey on a user is refused.

get.description: List threads in the authenticated user's mailbox. Forwards query string to the mailbox DO.
Return all messages in a thread.

delete.description: Cascade-delete every message + attachment + R2 blob in a thread. Returns the count of R2 objects swept.

patch.description: Update message flags (starred/read/archived) or move it to another thread.

post.description: Send an outbound message via the EMAIL binding and seal a copy for the sender's mailbox.

get.description: WebSocket upgrade. Handed off to the MailboxDO which broadcasts message.new / draft.upsert / draft.delete events.

Image proxy. Fetches a remote image URL through the worker so the recipient's IP never reaches the sender. Auth'd — only the email viewer should consume this. Returns image bytes with a 24h public cache header.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Absolute http(s) image URL to fetch.

200.description: Image bytes; content-type passthrough from upstream.

400.description: Bad URL, blocked host, or non-image content-type.

post.description: Create or upsert a draft. ID is supplied by the client for idempotent autosaves.
Toggle a label on a message.

get.description: List attachment metadata for a message. Filenames are ciphertext (sealed-to-self); the client decrypts.
Stream back the encrypted attachment bytes.

200.description: Raw bytes; content-type from R2 metadata.

post.description: Begin an R2 multipart upload. Returns the (r2_key, upload_id) handle the client uses for /parts and /complete. The `kind` picks the R2 prefix (attach / hosted / secret) and post-complete bookkeeping.
Upload one part of a multipart upload. Body is raw bytes (≤ 6 MiB). Required headers: x-r2-key, x-upload-id, x-part-number (1-indexed).
Finalize a multipart upload. For kind=attach, also registers an attachment row in MailboxDO and returns `attachment_id`.
Abort an in-flight multipart upload. Best-effort cleanup; R2 also expires abandoned multiparts eventually.
Mint a secret link from previously-uploaded ciphertext + the password-derived check value.

get.description: Sender dashboard: list every secret link the current user has minted.

post.description: Revoke a secret link and delete its R2 attachment blobs.

get.description: Public viewer metadata (no password required). Returns hint, sender display, KDF params, salt, policy + state. The viewer derives Argon2id locally before calling /open.

post.description: Public unlock. Server compares password_check_b64 against the stored check value. Bumps fail_count on miss; self-destructs the row at the 10th miss.
Public per-chunk ciphertext fetch. Re-verifies the password check; does NOT advance policy state. Optional offset+length for ranged reads (one chunk per call).

200.description: Raw ciphertext for the requested range.

post.description: Mint a hosted-download row. Server never sees the CEK; the client embeds it in the URL fragment when emailing the link.

get.description: Sender dashboard: list hosted links + per-row `sender_cek_wrap_b64` so the sender can re-decrypt locally.

post.description: Revoke a hosted-download link and delete its R2 blobs.

get.description: Public landing-page metadata. Sender identity (cleartext), file list (cleartext filenames + mimes), expiry. The CEK to decrypt the bytes lives in the URL fragment.
Stream one file's ciphertext. Supports HTTP Range for resumable browser downloads. Server returns `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` because it doesn't know the real mime.

parameters.name: r2_key
parameters.description: Must be a key listed on this row's `files`.

post.description: Issue a new invite. Admin-only.

delete.description: Revoke an unredeemed invite. Refuses if the invite has already been redeemed (those are audit trail).

post.description: Attach an additional owned address to a user.

get.description: Unauthenticated bootstrap-status probe used on first load.

post.description: Dump every DO (registry + every mailbox) to a JSON bundle at `backups/<iso>.json` in R2. Same code path the scheduled daily backup uses.

get.description: List backup bundles in R2 + the cron schedule the scheduled handler runs on.

post.description: Replay a backup bundle. Registry rows go first (so user_ids exist when MailboxDO rows reference them). Each table uses INSERT OR REPLACE so re-running is idempotent.

ContactView.description:
One row in the authenticated user's derived contact list.

Derived (not stored): we scan the user's MailboxDO messages on each
`/api/contacts` call and dedupe by canonical email address. There is
no separate contacts table — the source of truth is the message log.
The client caches the result in IndexedDB with a short TTL and
invalidates on send.

name.description:
Most recent display name we've seen for this address, if any.
Comes from `from_name` on inbound messages; outbound recipients
have no name source (we only get raw addresses there) so it's
`None` until they reply.

last_seen_at.description: `sent_at` of the most recent message touching this contact.

message_count.description:
Total number of messages (inbound + outbound) involving this
contact. Used by the typeahead to break ties when scoring
suggestions.

error.description:
Human-readable error message. Status code carries the category
(400/401/403/404/409/500).

ttl_days.description: TTL override; server clamps to [1, 30] days.

sender_cek_wrap_b64.description:
CEK sealed to sender's own X25519 pubkey. Lets the sender
re-decrypt from the /hosted dashboard later. Public viewer
endpoints never expose this.

url_prefix.description:
URL prefix WITHOUT the `#k=<key>` fragment — caller appends
the fragment client-side so the CEK never reaches the server.

sender_cek_wrap_b64.description:
Sender-only — base64url of `seal_to(sender_pub, cek)`. Only
returned on /api/hosted/mine, never on the public view.

load_by_default.description:
Load remote images for every sender (always via the `/api/img` proxy,
so the sender never sees the recipient's IP).

domains.description: Allowlisted sender domains whose remote images load automatically.

kdf_params.description: JSON-encoded KDF params for recovery wraps; null for passkey wraps.

body_html_ct_b64.description:
Optional sealed HTML body. Inbound messages with a text/html
MIME part populate this; outbound messages composed with rich
formatting do too. When present the viewer prefers it (rendered
in a sandboxed iframe) and falls back to body_ct otherwise.

sealed_proof_b64.description: Random token sealed to the user's X25519 pubkey.

wraps.description: Two wraps required: one passkey, one recovery. Pass-through to the DO.

filename_ct_b64.description:
Single chunk of XChaCha20-Poly1305 framed ciphertext of the
filename, under the secret-link CEK.

chunk_size.description:
Uniform plaintext bytes per chunk (last may be smaller). 0
means "treat as non-chunked single blob" — pre-chunked legacy.

offset.description:
Optional byte range. When both fields are provided the worker
issues an R2 ranged GET; otherwise serves the whole object.

recipient.description: Email recipient (compose flow). Absent for /share standalone links.

r2_key.description: R2 key produced by the unified upload pipeline (`kind=attach`).

filename.description:
Plain filename for the outbound MIME Content-Disposition. Never
stored server-side in cleartext — see `filename_ct_b64`.

filename_ct_b64.description: Sealed-to-self filename stored on the sender's MailboxDO row.

attachments.description:
Inline-MIME attachments. The hosted-link path is now driven
entirely client-side (see /api/hosted/create) — large files
become links spliced into `text`/`html` BEFORE this call.

ThreadSummary.description:
Thread summary returned by `GET /api/threads`. The actual shape is owned
by the mailbox DO; this is a best-effort mirror so the spec has
*something* to point at. Update as the DO surface stabilizes.

size.description: Sum of part lengths (ciphertext bytes uploaded).

filename_ct_b64.description: `attach` only — sealed filename to store on MailboxDO.

mime.description: `attach` only — real mime for outbound MIME assembly.

draft_id.description:
`attach` only — bind the new attachment row to a draft so
draft-cleanup paths can find it.

attachment_id.description: `attach` kind only — id of the row registered in MailboxDO.

mime.description:
Optional MIME hint stored as R2 http_metadata. Encrypted-kind
uploads almost always use `application/octet-stream` here
because the bytes are ciphertext.
